title: Immediate in-chat feedback for Compact Context and removal of tooltip on 'Сжать контекст' button
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer & react-tailwind-artisan)
summary: Removed disruptive native browser tooltip from 'Сжать контекст' button in DrawerSteerBar and implemented immediate optimistic in-chat feedback for context compaction. Synchronized deterministic tool_id between React drawerStore and Rust backend compact_context command, broadcasting agent:tool_call at start, updating with execution duration and token savings badge (-X токенов) upon completion, and persisting under the exact same ID in SQLite dialog_items table to eliminate duplicate cards or UI flicker on dialog reload. Refactored ContextGauge to reuse compactTaskContext.
